contents.name: Finite-dimensional Schatten-1 definition
contents.reason: The complete §1.1.3 passage defines the finite-dimensional Schatten norms. Chapter 1 is explicitly a proof-free review; the local theorems are proved from inspected root suppliers.

contents.name: Trace norm as the trace of the positive square root
contents.reason: Equation (1.181) states the trace formula; the local proof derives it from the published singular-value and finite spectral definitions.

contents.name: Trace norm unitary invariance and positive-operator formula
contents.reason: The §1.1.3 Schatten-norm identities support unitary invariance, and the inspected finite positive spectral treatment supports the positive case; both local assertions are proved from the root SVD and positivity suppliers.

contents.name: Trace-norm dual formula and Schatten Hölder inequality
contents.reason: Watrous Eqs. (1.173)–(1.174) support the exact trace/operator-norm dual interface; the submitted SVD argument proves the finite rectangular case locally.

contents.name: Schatten Hölder inequality
contents.reason: Equation (1.174) states the trace/operator-norm Hölder bound. The local proposition also derives it from the proved duality formula for finite rectangular maps.

contents.name: Hermitian positive/negative parts and trace norm in state discrimination
contents.reason: The Jordan–Hahn decomposition and §3.1.1 trace-norm argument support the positive/negative spectral split. The local proof derives both identities directly from finite spectral data.

contents.name: Dirac notation
contents.reason: Watrous explicitly does not use Dirac notation. Its linear-algebra conventions are recorded as contrast/context only; de Wolf A.3 and A.10 support the bra/ket interface.

contents.name: Bra/ket notation, inner-product convention and outer-product action
contents.reason: Appendices A.3 and A.10 explicitly state the source convention and identify kets, bras and outer products. The local definition reverses the pairing to match the root linear-first convention.

contents.name: Amplitude and coordinate translation under the root convention
contents.reason: Appendices A.3, A.5 and A.10 supply the linear-algebra and notation context. The exact root-convention amplitude identity is proved from the published adjoint definition.

contents.name: Finite rectangular singular-value decomposition
contents.reason: Appendix A.5 states the arbitrary rectangular SVD. The local unitary-invariance proof uses an SVD route, but its zero-singular-vector completion is taken from the complete published root theorem.

contents.name: SVD support for finite trace-norm formulas
contents.reason: Appendix A.5 supports the finite rectangular SVD reduction. Its construction is abbreviated at zero singular values, so it is not used as the proof supplier; the complete root SVD proof is used.

contents.name: SVD and trace support for unitary/positive trace-norm interfaces
contents.reason: Appendices A.5 and A.7 supply the independent SVD and trace context. The local proof uses published root SVD, finite isometry and trace definitions.
